Calculates execution duration and axis peak step counts for binary steps.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.binary.metrics.binary_metrics_calculator.BinaryMetricsCalculator[source]¶

Bases: object

Calculates execution duration and axis peak step counts for binary steps.

It defines:

methods:
calculate_metrics - Computes total duration and peak step counts.
calculate_telemetry - Computes comprehensive binary execution telemetry.
calculate_metrics(*, steps: Sequence[Step]) → tuple[int, tuple[int, int, int, int]][source]¶

Computes total duration in microseconds and peak axis step counts.

Parameters:

steps – Sequence of Step instances.

Returns:

Tuple of (total_duration_us, (peak_j0, peak_j1, peak_z, peak_pitch)).

Exceptions:

None.

calculate_telemetry(*, steps: Sequence[Step], raw_bytes: bytes) → BinaryProgramTelemetry[source]¶

Computes comprehensive binary execution telemetry and axis step metrics.

Parameters:

  • steps – Sequence of Step instances.

  • raw_bytes – Compiled binary raw byte sequence.

Returns:

BinaryProgramTelemetry domain model.

Exceptions:

None.
